game.q: years later, in medina, bilal is given a famous job. what is it?
opts: the first to give the call to prayer

wrong.judge: a big role, but not bilal’s. think voice.
wrong.keys: an honoured job, but not his.

game.right: YES. the first muezzin. the voice that said “one” under the rock now called a city to prayer.

end.line: under a rock in the noon sun, bilal said one word, and it held his whole faith.

cliff.s2: a few crooked ones, and the one thing al-fatiha asks for.
cliff.tmr: tomorrow: a line in the sand.

share: hot sand. a heavy rock. one word: ahad. bilal’s story on infinite hill
